role: rank which truncation point of the current SENSO parent to revisit

architecture.output_during_ranking: raw score; higher = better completion estimate

objective.label: standardized negative final_count
objective.standardization: target = (-final_count - mean(-final_count on training rows)) / std(-final_count on training rows)
objective.normalization_fit: training seeds 1-18 and 1001-1020 only; computed fresh; no v1 normalization reuse

training.checkpoint_choice: highest calibration concordance, then lowest calibration MSE, then earliest epoch
training.duplicate_training_replay: same exported float arrays and SHA-256 required

offline_validation.primary_metric: pairwise concordance between model score and lower final_count within each seed, ties score 0.5
offline_validation.pass_rule: concordance strictly greater than 0.5 with at least one unequal-final-size pair

integration.note: Integration patch and proposal policy identical to E4/V2; only the model weights change
integration.scored_inference: compiled float32 CPU inference on M4; no Python, GPU, network, LLM, or adaptive state

frozen_unchanged_components: SENSO parent ranking and estimate fraction
random seed and all non-truncation RNG behavior
integration patch (same frozen patch as E4)
